segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text: Our site still looks like a pre-Series B company, and enterprise buyers do not see the depth of our security platform.

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks
segments.text: We need the site to support the fundraising story and give sales a clear enterprise narrative before the launch.

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text: WordPress has become hard to maintain. Marketing needs approved page templates we can use without a developer.

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks
segments.text: Accessibility and performance matter because our buyers include regulated financial institutions.

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text: We need to see which partner and campaign sources turn into qualified demos.

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks
segments.text: A phased engagement works if discovery starts this quarter and the core site is ready for the Series B announcement.

segments.speaker: Priya Nair
segments.text: We acquired three SaaS products and each brand now has a separate site, message, and conversion flow.

segments.speaker: Daniel Ross
segments.text: Buyers cannot tell when products work together, so cross-sell conversations start from scratch.

segments.speaker: Priya Nair
segments.text: We need a shared design and template system, but each product team still needs room for its own campaign pages.

segments.speaker: Daniel Ross
segments.text: The new system needs to meet accessibility standards across every product site.

segments.speaker: Priya Nair
segments.text: We want one reporting view that shows source, product interest, and conversion across the portfolio.

segments.speaker: Daniel Ross
segments.text: Start with the highest-revenue product and create a repeatable rollout plan for the other two.

segments.speaker: Dr. Aisha Patel
segments.text: Patients and referring providers struggle to find the right service line and location on the current site.

segments.speaker: Noah Grant
segments.text: We need clearer referral pathways, especially for our specialty clinics.

segments.speaker: Dr. Aisha Patel
segments.text: Accessibility confidence is non-negotiable for our patient population and compliance team.

segments.speaker: Noah Grant
segments.text: Our communications team needs approved modules to publish physician and service updates quickly.

segments.speaker: Dr. Aisha Patel
segments.text: We cannot show which campaigns produce completed referral forms or appointments.

segments.speaker: Noah Grant
segments.text: We would like a focused first phase before committing to the full network rollout.
